comments.why: Shows the difference between one-dimensional flexbox and two-dimensional grid.
comments.text: They serve different purposes, and you'll often want to use both for different pieces of the layout. Flexbox is for laying things out in one dimension, Grid is more for two-dimensional ones. This video might help show the difference (and all the Layout Land videos are great if you want to look more into CSS grid): [VIDEO]
